Ecosystem Fruit Vinegar Hair Color Gel Dye – Nourishing, Long-Lasting Hair Color with Natural Shine – All Hair Types
Description:
Experience a refreshing way to color your hair with the Ecosystem Fruit Vinegar Hair Color Gel Dye, a unique formula that blends vibrant pigments with the nourishing power of fruit vinegar. This innovative dye not only delivers rich, long-lasting color but also helps restore hair’s natural pH balance, leaving it smooth, glossy, and revitalized.
The gel-based texture ensures even application from roots to ends, minimizing mess and maximizing coverage. Fruit vinegar helps seal the cuticle, lock in color, and add natural shine while reducing dryness and frizz. Perfect for covering grays, refreshing faded tones, or trying a bold new shade, it offers salon-quality results right at home.
Suitable for all hair types, this dye provides a gentle yet effective coloring experience, making it ideal for frequent use without overly damaging your strands.
